```{r}

  read_rds() |> 
  emmeans::emmeans(
    pairwise ~ asthma_pct,
    weight = "cells", 
    offset = log(1000*176),
    type = "response",
    at = list(asthma_pct = c(.03, .05, .07))
    )
  
```
